your interest will be immediately diluted to the extent of the difference between the initial public offering price per share of Common
Stock in this offering and the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share of Common Stock after this offering. Dilution results

common share (post-split), based on 5,190,024 shares of Common Stock outstanding. Our net tangible book value (deficit) per share represents

cite.text: Helio Corp /FL/ · S-1 filed Oct 21, 2026 · Nine months ended Jul 31, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $1.5M in 9M to Jul 2026, down 54% year over year.

Gross margin was 41.4%, up 20.6 points from 9M to Jul 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $4.1M, an operating margin of -264.2%. Operating expenses grew 39% against revenue growth of -54%. The fastest-growing cost line was General & admin (+62%). The period ended with a net loss of $6.9M.
Operating cash flow was −$1.9M. Non-cash charges added back $17K of depreciation and $81K of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items added $4.8M.
